AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-06-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.
Petitioner, Maria Eufemia Alonzo, was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Kevin Eduardo Pascual.
Petitioner was placed under oath and testified.
Ricardo Pena was placed under oath and served as Spanish speaking interpreter for petitioner.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Kevin Eduardo Alonzo.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Denise Doucette.
Petitioner: Maria Eufemia Pascual, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Kevin Eduardo Pascual, and with Spanish Interpreter: Luis Alonso.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to Nov. 20, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner file an Application with declaration for an Order dispensing with notice.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
